feeTiers.note: SaphraBulkPay and SaphraPayroll fee bands on the batch/run total, in 6-decimal units. Band i covers totals up to and including upTo[i] and charges fees[i]; above the last bound pays the last fee. The fee is never less than recipientFeeMin x people paid. Keep in step with apps/web/lib/fees.ts (bulkFeeTiers).
